title: Tattletail mod
description: this mod adds Tattletail from the horror title Tattletail in a attempt to mimic the feel of the game in minecraft
body:
![Tattletail icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47a7367b7577887bcf652539efe3dcb57569dc8c.png)

# Description
this is a mod for minecraft that attemts to mimic the feel of playing the indie horror tittle Tattletail in a survival friendly way

to start the mod you must obtain a X-mas Tree by crafting it then once you place it down let the night pass and buy morning you'll have a present under the tree!

on opening the present you'll be greeted with a talking tattletail, a brush, and a charger

you'll need these item's and a craftable frige to keep tattletail quiet

you also can't place them to close to each other
